dimensions.assessment: Affects public land users, energy development entities, and residents in North Dakota subject to BLM land management rules.
dimensions.evidence: North Dakota Field Office Record of Decision and Approved Resource Management Plan

dimensions.assessment: Completely nullifies an agency resource management plan that previously limited oil and gas development and coal leasing.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect

dimensions.assessment: Potential economic and revenue effects on energy leasing and extraction are implied by removing development limitations, but no specific monetary figures are stated.
dimensions.evidence: limiting development of oil and gas in low-potential areas and new coal leasing

dimensions.assessment: Uses Congressional Review Act procedures to invalidate an executive branch agency rule and plan.
dimensions.evidence: providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule

dimensions.assessment: Permanent nullification of the specific BLM rule and record of decision.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect

missing_information: Specific economic impact data or quantified changes in federal leasing revenues resulting from nullification are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: Disapproves and nullifies a Bureau of Land Management resource management plan and record of decision governing public lands in North Dakota.
